summary: Tested Admin Send FTC and Enhanced Global Ledger features. All 11 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI correctly displays Admin Send FTC modal, Admin Transfer History, Header navigation (Mining, Plans, Wallet, Ledger, Admin), User profile button, and Global Blockchain Ledger with ADMIN_SEND transaction type.
seed_data_creation: Admin Send FTC transactions created during testing (10 FTC, 25 FTC, 50 FTC, 75 FTC, 100 FTC)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Send FTC feature fully functional. Admin can send FTC to any user from admin wallet with no fee deduction. Admin Transfer History shows all admin transfers. Global Blockchain Ledger shows ADMIN_SEND transaction type with sender/receiver wallet addresses. Transaction details API returns full blockchain info including network (Solana Mainnet) and gas fee.
